nodes.title: SG-5.3 · Round service wired into admin routes and scheduler
nodes.body:
Context: backend/internal/server/server.go already builds round.Service (newRoundService), adapts it with roundAdmin and roundDefaults, and mounts the five admin round routes under admin.Middleware. cmd/server/main.go already runs server.NewScheduler(cfg).Run(ctx). Desired behavior: this wiring is confirmed against the code and covered by passing route tests. Expected result: go test ./internal/server passes. Why: sub-goal SG-5.3 must be met without duplicating work that exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a token-less request, when any admin round route is called, then the response is 401
- Given Bearer token and an existing round, when each admin round route is called, then the response is not 404
- Given main starts, when the server runs, then the scheduler Run loop is started on the shared context


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server.go wiring
- In scope: backend/cmd/server/main.go scheduler start
- Out of scope: Changing round lifecycle logic
- Out of scope: Frontend or worker changes
- Preserve: Existing admin handler contracts
- Preserve: Git-backed storage, no database


## Technical constraints
- Go with chi router
- No database


## Definition of done
- Admin round routes mounted behind token middleware
- Scheduler started in main
- Route tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Admin round endpoints are mounted behind the admin token
nodes.body:
Context: server.New registers POST /rounds, POST /rounds/{id}/open, POST /rounds/{id}/close, GET /rounds/{id} and GET /rounds/{id}/contributions inside r.Route("/api/v1/admin") with admin.Middleware(cfg.Admin.Token). Desired behavior: each route reaches its admin.RoundHandler method only with a valid bearer token. Expected result: unauthenticated calls get 401, authenticated calls reach the handler. Why: protects round control from the public.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given no Authorization header, when POST /api/v1/admin/rounds is called, then status is 401
- Given Bearer tok and an existing round, when GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001 is called, then status is not 404


## Scope
- In scope: Admin round route registration in server.New
- Out of scope: Handler logic changes
- Preserve: Executions routes in the same admin group


## Technical constraints
- Routes stay under admin.Middleware


## Definition of done
- Five round routes registered in the admin group


## Non-functional requirements
- Admin token never logged


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Scheduler is built from config and started in main
nodes.body:
Context: server.NewScheduler wires round.Service, round.FileStore, a world lister and cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval; main.go launches it with go Run(ctx). Desired behavior: scheduler is constructed from config with controller and store set. Expected result: NewScheduler returns a scheduler with the configured interval. Why: rounds must open and close automatically.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given round.scheduler_interval 7s, when NewScheduler is built, then Interval is 7s
- Given a temp repo_path, when NewScheduler is built, then Controller and Rounds are non-nil


## Scope
- In scope: server.NewScheduler
- In scope: main.go scheduler start
- Out of scope: Scheduler tick logic
- Preserve: Graceful shutdown on interrupt


## Technical constraints
- Scheduler uses the injected config only


## Definition of done
- NewScheduler wired and started in main


## Clarifying questions
- None
